name: quote
title: Quote
description: Words that belong to someone else, set apart from yours.
use: A quotation set apart from the text, on a blockquote, with its source under it. Use one pull quote on a page and keep it to a sentence or two.

instead.when: The words are one turn of a conversation
A sentence points at its source with a number
A phrase of your own text is highlighted

classes.name: quote
classes.description: The quotation, hung from a 2px rail at its start

classes.name: quote-lg
classes.description: A pull quote: larger words with balanced lines under an opening mark instead of the rail

classes.name: quote-source
classes.description: Who said it and where: an optional avatar beside a name and a muted line

classes.name: quote-name
classes.description: The name, in strong ink on its own line
